page.content:
The Rainmaker — CHAOS ace and record IWGP champion.

How Kazuchika Okada connects

  • Faction: CHAOS — Okada was the Rainmaker ace of CHAOS.
  • Item: IWGP World Heavyweight Championship — Okada's record IWGP reigns defined the Rainmaker era.
  • Character: Hiroshi Tanahashi — Okada and Tanahashi's rivalry rebuilt New Japan's main event.
  • Character: Jay White — Jay White's Switchblade run was built on feuds with Okada.

What is Kazuchika Okada?

Kazuchika Okada, CHAOS's Rainmaker, held the IWGP Heavyweight Championship for a company-record reign and headlined repeated Wrestle Kingdom main events against Tanahashi, Omega, and Naito.

Key threads lead to CHAOS, IWGP World Heavyweight Championship, Hiroshi Tanahashi and Jay White.
